item.title: Please Allow Ads on Shiguangji
item.description:
A simple change in your browser settings can make a real difference to the future of this website.

Shiguangji is currently supported mainly by advertising revenue.

That revenue helps cover the everyday costs of running the website, including hosting, domain renewal, software testing, content research, technical maintenance, and the continued publication of free articles.

We want to keep most of the content on this website freely available without placing everything behind a paywall or requiring visitors to purchase a membership.

For that reason, if you are using an ad-blocking extension, we sincerely invite you to add Shiguangji to your allowlist.

You do not need to disable your ad blocker on every website. Allowing ads only on Shiguangji is enough to support the site while keeping your usual protection elsewhere.

Why Advertising Matters to Shiguangji

Every tutorial, tool review, project note, and troubleshooting guide requires time, testing, research, and ongoing maintenance.

Advertising revenue helps support:

  • Website hosting and network services
  • Domain renewal and technical maintenance
  • Software, tools, and service testing
  • Article research, editing, and updates
  • Website development and security
  • The continued publication of free content

For you, allowing ads may take only a few seconds.

For Shiguangji, that small action helps turn free visits into sustainable support for future content.

About the Ads Displayed on This Website

Shiguangji uses Google AdSense to provide advertising.

Google AdSense is an advertising service operated by Google for website publishers. Advertisements delivered through the platform are subject to Google’s advertising policies, technical standards, and review systems.

Shiguangji may also use the management and review tools provided by Google AdSense to monitor, block, or report unsuitable advertisements.

We make reasonable efforts to reduce advertisements that may be:

  • Misleading
  • Irrelevant to the website
  • Disruptive to normal reading
  • Inappropriate or uncomfortable
  • Potentially inconsistent with platform policies

However, advertisements are delivered dynamically based on factors such as your location, device, browsing environment, page content, and advertising preferences.

Because of this, Shiguangji cannot review every advertisement before it appears to every visitor.

If you notice an advertisement that appears inappropriate, misleading, or suspicious, please contact us and include a screenshot and the page URL whenever possible. We will review the issue and take appropriate action through the available advertising controls.

You Do Not Need to Disable Your Ad Blocker Everywhere

To protect your browsing preferences and security, we recommend adding Shiguangji to your allowlist instead of disabling your ad blocker globally.

After adding the site to your allowlist:

  • Your ad blocker will continue working on other websites
  • Ads will only be permitted on Shiguangji
  • You can restore blocking for this website at any time
  • You do not need to uninstall any browser extension

After changing the setting, please refresh the current page.

Google Chrome Instructions

Method 1: Allow Ads Through the Extension Icon

This is usually the easiest and most convenient method.

  1. Open Shiguangji in Google Chrome.
  2. Click the Extensions icon in the upper-right corner of the browser.
  3. Find the ad-blocking extension you are using.
  4. Click the extension icon to open its control panel.
  5. Select an option such as:
    • Pause on this site
    • Allow ads on this site
    • Trust this site
    • Add to allowlist
  6. Refresh the page.

The exact wording may vary depending on the extension, but most ad blockers provide an option to disable blocking for the current website only.

Method 2: Temporarily Disable the Extension

If you are not sure which extension is blocking the ads, you can temporarily disable the relevant extension.

  1. Open Google Chrome.
  2. Click the three-dot menu in the upper-right corner.
  3. Select Extensions.
  4. Open Manage Extensions.
  5. Find the ad-blocking extension.
  6. Turn off the extension using the switch.
  7. Return to Shiguangji and refresh the page.

You can also enter the following address directly into the browser:

chrome://extensions/

Then press Enter.

Please note that this method disables the extension on all websites until you turn it back on.

Instructions for Common Ad-Blocking Extensions

AdBlock

  1. Open Shiguangji.
  2. Click the AdBlock icon in the Chrome toolbar.
  3. Select the option that allows ads on the current website.
  4. Confirm the change if prompted.
  5. Refresh the page.

Depending on the version, the option may appear as:

  • Allow ads on this site
  • Pause on this site
  • Always allow ads on this site
  • Add to allowlist

Choose the option that applies only to the current website.

Adblock Plus

  1. Open Shiguangji.
  2. Click the Adblock Plus icon in the browser toolbar.
  3. Open the extension settings.
  4. Find the list of allowed websites.
  5. Add the Shiguangji domain.
  6. Save the setting and refresh the page.

Some versions also provide a switch labeled:

This website

or:

Block ads on this website

Turn off blocking for the current website only.

uBlock Origin

  1. Open Shiguangji.
  2. Click the uBlock Origin icon in the Chrome toolbar.
  3. Click the large power button in the extension panel.
  4. Confirm that the power button changes to the disabled state.
  5. Refresh the page.

This setting normally applies only to the current website.

Click the power button again if you later want to restore blocking on Shiguangji.

uBlock Origin Lite

  1. Open Shiguangji.
  2. Click the uBlock Origin Lite icon.
  3. Find the filtering level for the current website.
  4. Change the filtering setting to:

No filtering

  1. Refresh the page.

This change normally applies only to the current website and does not affect filtering on other websites.

AdGuard AdBlocker

  1. Open Shiguangji.
  2. Click the AdGuard icon in the Chrome toolbar.
  3. Find the option related to filtering on the current website.
  4. Turn off filtering for Shiguangji.
  5. Refresh the page.

You may also open the AdGuard settings and add Shiguangji to the:

Allowlist

After that, AdGuard will continue working normally on other websites.

Ghostery

  1. Open Shiguangji.
  2. Click the Ghostery icon in the browser toolbar.
  3. Choose to pause protection or trust the current website.
  4. Select a permanent option such as:

Always

or:

Always trust this site

  1. Refresh the page.

Ghostery will continue protecting you on other websites while allowing Shiguangji to display ads.

Built-In Browser Ad Blocking

Some Chromium-based browsers include their own advertising, tracking, or privacy protection features.

If you have not installed an ad-blocking extension but still see a warning that ads are blocked, look near the address bar for:

  • An ad-blocking notice
  • A shield icon
  • A privacy protection icon
  • A tracking protection message
  • A blocked content notification

Click the relevant icon and allow advertising or disable protection for the current website, then refresh the page.

Still Not Working?

If you have already added Shiguangji to your allowlist but the website still reports that ads are blocked, try the following steps.

1. Refresh the Page

After changing the settings, perform a full refresh.

On Windows, press:

Ctrl + F5

On macOS, press:

Command + Shift + R

2. Check for Multiple Blocking Extensions

Some users have more than one advertising, privacy, script, or tracking extension installed.

Examples include:

  • AdBlock
  • Adblock Plus
  • uBlock Origin
  • uBlock Origin Lite
  • AdGuard
  • Ghostery
  • Privacy Badger
  • NoScript
  • Browser privacy extensions

Even if one extension allows Shiguangji, another extension may continue blocking advertising.

Please check each relevant extension and add the website to its allowlist.

3. Check Security Software or DNS Filtering

Advertisements may also be blocked by software or services outside the browser.

Common examples include:

  • Antivirus web protection
  • Router-level ad blocking
  • AdGuard DNS
  • NextDNS
  • Pi-hole
  • Proxy or filtering rules
  • Company or school network policies
  • Privacy-focused DNS services

If you have disabled your browser extensions but the warning remains, one of these services may be responsible.

4. Clear Cache and Cookies

You may also try clearing the cache and cookies for the current website and then reopening the page.

Please note that clearing cookies may sign you out or reset certain website preferences.

Thank You for Supporting Shiguangji

Shiguangji aims to keep most of its content free and accessible while avoiding advertising formats that seriously interfere with reading.

We understand that everyone has different browsing habits, and we respect your decision about whether to use an ad blocker.

Still, allowing ads on Shiguangji is one of the most direct and practical ways to support the website.

Every visit, article view, and share helps Shiguangji continue publishing useful content.

Free content is not free to produce. It simply means someone else is covering the cost.

Thank you for supporting Shiguangji.

item.title: 请允许拾光集展示广告
item.description:
您的一次简单设置，就是对拾光集持续更新最直接的支持。

拾光集目前主要依靠广告收入维持网站的日常运营，包括服务器、域名、内容整理、工具测试以及网站维护等相关成本。

本站绝大多数内容都可以免费阅读。我们希望在不设置付费墙、不强制购买会员的前提下，继续分享真实测试过的工具、项目经验和问题解决方法。

因此，如果您正在使用广告拦截插件，诚挚邀请您将 拾光集 加入允许列表。

您不需要关闭所有网站的广告拦截功能，只需允许本站展示广告，即可帮助网站继续运营和更新。

广告对拾光集意味着什么

每一篇教程、工具推荐和问题记录，背后都需要投入一定的时间和成本。

广告收入主要用于支持：

  • 服务器与网络服务
  • 域名续费及网站维护
  • 软件、工具与服务测试
  • 内容整理与文章更新
  • 网站功能开发与安全防护
  • 免费内容的持续发布

对您而言，允许本站展示广告可能只是一次点击。

对拾光集而言，这份支持会转化为更多实用内容、更稳定的访问体验，以及更长久的网站运营。

关于本站广告的说明

拾光集目前使用 Google AdSense 提供广告服务。

Google AdSense 是 Google 面向网站发布者提供的广告服务。相关广告需要遵守 Google 的广告政策和平台规范。

拾光集也会通过 Google AdSense 提供的广告审核和屏蔽工具，对已经展示或可能展示的广告进行管理。

我们会尽力减少以下类型的广告：

  • 具有误导性的广告
  • 与网站内容明显不相关的广告
  • 影响正常阅读的广告
  • 令人不适或存在争议的广告
  • 可能违反平台政策的广告

但广告内容由第三方广告系统根据地区、设备、页面内容及广告设置等因素动态提供，本站无法事先逐一确认每位用户看到的全部广告。

如您发现不合适、误导性或疑似存在安全问题的广告，请及时联系我们，并尽量提供广告截图和所在页面，我们会进行检查并通过广告管理工具处理。

我们不会要求您全局关闭广告拦截

为了兼顾您的浏览安全和使用习惯，我们更推荐以下方式：

仅将拾光集加入广告允许列表。

完成设置后：

  • 广告拦截插件在其他网站仍会正常工作
  • 只有拾光集可以正常展示广告
  • 您可以随时重新开启本站的广告拦截
  • 不需要卸载任何浏览器插件

设置完成后，请刷新当前页面。

Google Chrome 设置方法

方法一：通过插件图标允许本站广告

这是最简单、最推荐的方法。

  1. 使用 Google Chrome 打开拾光集。
  2. 点击浏览器右上角的“扩展程序”图标。
  3. 找到您正在使用的广告拦截插件。
  4. 点击插件图标打开控制面板。
  5. 选择“在此网站暂停”“允许此网站的广告”“信任此网站”或类似选项。
  6. 刷新当前页面。

不同插件的按钮名称可能略有不同，但通常都会提供针对当前网站关闭拦截的功能。

方法二：暂时关闭广告拦截扩展

如果您无法确定是哪一个插件阻止了广告，可以暂时关闭相关扩展。

  1. 打开 Google Chrome。
  2. 点击右上角的三个点。
  3. 依次选择“扩展程序”和“管理扩展程序”。
  4. 找到广告拦截类插件。
  5. 关闭插件右下方的开关。
  6. 返回拾光集并刷新页面。

您也可以在地址栏输入：

chrome://extensions/

然后按回车键，直接进入扩展程序管理页面。

请注意，这种方式会暂时停止该插件在所有网站上的运行。完成查看后，您可以重新开启插件。

常见广告拦截插件设置方法

AdBlock

  1. 打开拾光集页面。
  2. 点击 Chrome 工具栏中的 AdBlock 图标。
  3. 选择允许本站广告或将当前网站加入允许列表的选项。
  4. 按照插件提示确认。
  5. 刷新页面。

部分版本可能显示为：

  • Allow ads on this site
  • Pause on this site
  • Always allow ads on this site
  • Add to allowlist

请选择仅针对当前网站生效的选项。

Adblock Plus

  1. 打开拾光集。
  2. 点击浏览器右上角的 Adblock Plus 图标。
  3. 点击插件面板中的设置按钮。
  4. 进入允许的网站列表。
  5. 添加拾光集的网站域名。
  6. 保存设置并刷新页面。

部分版本也可以直接关闭：

This website

或：

Block ads on this website

旁边的开关。

关闭后，只会允许当前网站展示广告，不会影响其他网站。

uBlock Origin

  1. 打开拾光集页面。
  2. 点击 Chrome 工具栏中的 uBlock Origin 图标。
  3. 点击面板中较大的电源按钮。
  4. 确认电源按钮变为关闭状态。
  5. 点击插件面板中的刷新按钮，或者手动刷新网页。

这一设置通常只会对当前网站生效。

再次点击电源按钮，即可恢复对本站的内容拦截。

uBlock Origin Lite

  1. 打开拾光集。
  2. 点击浏览器工具栏中的 uBlock Origin Lite 图标。
  3. 找到当前网站的过滤级别设置。
  4. 将过滤模式调整为：

No filtering

或中文界面中的：

不过滤

  1. 刷新当前页面。

该设置通常只针对当前网站，不会影响其他网站的过滤规则。

AdGuard 广告拦截器

  1. 打开拾光集页面。
  2. 点击 Chrome 工具栏中的 AdGuard 图标。
  3. 找到“在此网站上过滤”或类似开关。
  4. 关闭针对当前网站的过滤功能。
  5. 刷新页面。

您也可以进入 AdGuard 设置，将拾光集添加到：

Allowlist

或：

允许列表

加入允许列表后，AdGuard 在其他网站仍会保持正常运行。

Ghostery

  1. 打开拾光集。
  2. 点击浏览器工具栏中的 Ghostery 图标。
  3. 选择暂停保护或信任当前网站。
  4. 如果可以选择暂停时间，请选择：

Always

或：

始终信任

  1. 刷新页面。

选择始终信任后，Ghostery 会继续保护其他网站，只在拾光集暂停相关拦截。

浏览器自带广告拦截功能

某些浏览器或基于 Chromium 的浏览器，可能自带广告或跟踪内容拦截功能。

如果您没有安装广告拦截扩展，但页面仍提示广告被屏蔽，可以检查地址栏附近是否出现：

  • 广告已拦截
  • 内容已拦截
  • 跟踪保护
  • 盾牌图标
  • 隐私保护图标

点击相应图标后，选择允许当前网站展示广告或关闭当前网站的保护，然后刷新页面。

设置后仍然无法正常显示？

如果您已经将拾光集加入允许列表，但页面仍提示广告被拦截，可以尝试以下方法。

1. 刷新页面

设置完成后，请按：

Ctrl + F5

进行强制刷新。

Mac 用户可以使用：

Command + Shift + R

2. 检查是否安装了多个拦截插件

有些用户会同时安装多个广告、隐私或脚本拦截扩展。

例如：

  • AdBlock
  • Adblock Plus
  • uBlock Origin Lite
  • AdGuard
  • Ghostery
  • Privacy Badger
  • NoScript
  • 浏览器隐私保护工具

即使其中一个插件已经允许本站，其他插件仍可能继续拦截广告。

请逐个检查，并将拾光集加入相应的允许列表。

3. 检查安全软件或 DNS 过滤

部分杀毒软件、路由器、代理工具、DNS 服务或网络过滤程序，也可能自动屏蔽广告域名。

常见情况包括：

  • 安全软件的网页保护功能
  • 路由器广告过滤
  • AdGuard DNS
  • NextDNS
  • Pi-hole
  • Clash 过滤规则
  • 浏览器隐私模式
  • 公司或学校网络策略

如果浏览器扩展已经关闭但提示仍然存在，可能是上述工具正在进行过滤。

4. 清除缓存后重新访问

您可以清除当前网站的缓存和 Cookie，然后重新打开页面。

请注意，清除 Cookie 可能会退出当前网站的登录状态或重置部分网站设置。

感谢您的理解与支持

拾光集希望长期保持大部分内容免费，并尽量减少影响阅读体验的广告形式。

我们理解每个人都有自己的浏览习惯，也尊重您是否开启广告拦截的决定。

如果您愿意将拾光集加入允许列表，这会成为对网站最直接、最实际的支持。

您的每一次访问、阅读和分享，都在帮助拾光集继续走下去。

免费内容并非没有成本，只是有人选择替读者承担这些成本。

感谢您支持拾光集。

2. Supporting Documentation

When requesting the deletion, modification, or restriction of content, please provide as much of the following information as possible:

  • Proof of identity or legal entity registration
  • Evidence of ownership or legal rights
  • A letter of authorization, where the request is submitted by an agent
  • The exact URL of the relevant page
  • A clear description of the content to be deleted or modified
  • The reason for the request and relevant supporting facts
  • A valid email address for communication and follow-up

Documents submitted by a company or organization should preferably include an official stamp or other verifiable form of authorization.

Individuals should redact unnecessary sensitive personal information before submitting documents.

Materials submitted for verification will only be used to review and process the relevant request and will not be used for unrelated purposes.

Request Handling Process

Step 1: Prepare the Required Materials

Please prepare sufficient documentation to demonstrate your identity, ownership or authorization, and the nature of your request.

Your request should clearly identify:

  • The URL of the relevant page
  • The specific content involved
  • The action you are requesting
  • The factual and legal basis for the request

Step 2: Submit the Request by Email

Please send the required information and supporting documents to:

Email: admin@tood.win

We recommend using the following subject line:

Copyright Request | Page Title or Relevant Content

To support verification, recordkeeping, and follow-up, Shiguangji currently accepts and processes such requests primarily by email.

Step 3: Verification and Processing

After receiving your request, we may verify:

  • Whether the applicant is authorized to submit the request
  • Whether the supporting documents are complete and valid
  • Whether the identified content is currently available on the website
  • Whether the request is reasonable and adequately supported

Requests supported by complete documentation and clear facts will normally be reviewed and processed within a reasonable period.

More time may be required where the matter is complex, additional documents are needed, or third-party verification is necessary.

Important Notices

1. Incomplete Documentation

If a request does not include sufficient proof of identity, ownership, authorization, or the specific page involved, we may be unable to verify or process it.

Where the authenticity of a request or the ownership of the relevant rights cannot be reasonably confirmed, Shiguangji may request additional documentation.

2. False or Malicious Requests

Applicants must ensure that all information and supporting documents submitted are truthful, lawful, accurate, and valid.

If a request involves impersonation, forged documents, malicious reporting, fraud, or other unlawful activity, Shiguangji may stop processing the request and reserves the right to pursue further action where permitted by law.

3. No Paid Content Removal Services

Shiguangji does not accept payment for deleting posts, withdrawing articles, removing content, or processing complaints.

We have not authorized any individual, company, or agency to offer paid content-removal services on behalf of Shiguangji.

If anyone claims to represent this website and requests a so-called removal fee, processing fee, or agency fee, do not make any payment. Please protect your personal information and financial security.

4. Processing Results

For eligible and properly supported requests, Shiguangji will take reasonable action based on the facts and circumstances.

The result may include correcting content, adding a clarification, removing a link, deleting content, or keeping the existing content unchanged.

We will make reasonable efforts to reply through the email address used to submit the request. However, we cannot guarantee that every request will be handled exactly as requested by the applicant.

Contact Us

If you believe that content published by Shiguangji infringes upon your copyright, trademark rights, privacy rights, or other lawful rights and interests, please contact us at:

Email: admin@tood.win

Please include the relevant page URL, proof of your rights, and a clear description of the action requested so that we can review the matter efficiently.

Shiguangji respects original work, supports licensed products, and takes every genuine, reasonable, and properly supported rights request seriously.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
Last updated: July 21, 2026

We respect the privacy and personal information of every visitor.

This Privacy Policy explains what information may be collected when you visit or use this website, how that information may be used, and how you can manage your privacy choices.

1. Information We May Collect

When you browse this website or interact with us, we may collect the following types of information.

Information You Provide Voluntarily

When you contact us through comments, forms, or email, you may provide information such as:

  • Your name or nickname
  • Your email address
  • Comments, messages, or inquiry details
  • Other information you choose to provide

Please do not submit sensitive information, such as passwords, payment details, identification numbers, or bank account information, through public comment sections.

Information Collected Automatically

To maintain website functionality, analyze traffic, improve user experience, and protect website security, our servers or third-party services may automatically collect:

  • IP address
  • Browser type and operating system
  • Device type and basic device information
  • Date and time of access
  • Referring source and pages visited
  • Time spent on pages and basic interaction data

This information is generally used for analytics, troubleshooting, and security purposes. It is not normally used to identify you personally.

2. Cookies and Similar Technologies

This website may use cookies, local storage, and similar technologies to:

  • Store necessary website preferences
  • Analyze website traffic and usage
  • Improve loading speed and browsing experience
  • Measure advertising and promotional performance
  • Provide more relevant content or advertisements where permitted

You can view, delete, block, or restrict cookies through your browser settings.

Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect some website features, advertising preferences, or your overall browsing experience.

3. Third-Party Advertising Services

To help support the operation of this website, we may use third-party advertising services, including Google AdSense.

When you visit a page containing advertisements, Google and its advertising technology partners may receive certain information, including:

  • The URL of the page you are visiting
  • Your IP address
  • Browser and device information
  • Data related to advertisement views, clicks, and performance

Google and its partners may use cookies or similar technologies to measure advertising performance.

In regions where consent is legally required, information will only be used for personalized advertising after you have provided consent.

You may manage your personalized advertising preferences through the advertising settings provided by Google.

4. Affiliate Links and Promotional Disclosure

Some articles on this website may contain affiliate links, referral links, or promotional links to third-party services, including services such as Airalo, Spaceship, and Vultr.

When you register, subscribe, or make a purchase through one of these links, we may receive a referral commission.

This commission is generally paid by the service provider and does not increase the price you pay.

We aim to recommend products and services based on practical experience, usefulness, and relevance. However, pricing, availability, features, terms, and service quality are controlled by the respective third-party providers.

5. How We Use Information

The information collected through this website may be used to:

  • Provide, operate, maintain, and improve the website
  • Analyze website traffic and content performance
  • Improve website structure and browsing experience
  • Respond to inquiries, suggestions, and collaboration requests
  • Prevent spam, misuse, fraud, and security threats
  • Measure advertising and promotional performance
  • Comply with applicable laws and regulatory requirements
  • Protect the legal rights and interests of the website, its users, and other parties

We will not use personal information for purposes that are clearly unrelated to those described in this Privacy Policy.

6. Information Sharing and Disclosure

We do not sell your personal information.

However, certain information may be shared or disclosed in the following circumstances:

  • When you have provided clear consent
  • When third-party services are required for hosting, analytics, advertising, or security
  • When necessary to respond to a request you have submitted
  • When required by law, court order, or regulatory authority
  • When necessary to protect the rights, safety, or legal interests of the website, its users, or other parties

Third-party service providers may process information in accordance with their own privacy policies and terms.

7. Users in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, and Switzerland

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, we process personal information in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

Before using non-essential cookies or processing information for personalized advertising, the website may request your consent.

You may review, change, or withdraw your choices at any time through the privacy or consent management tools available on the website.

Withdrawing consent will not affect processing that was lawfully carried out before the withdrawal.

8. Privacy Rights for Residents of Certain U.S. States

If you are a resident of California or another U.S. state with applicable consumer privacy laws, you may have certain legal rights, including the right to:

  • Know what personal information we collect or process
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of eligible personal information
  • Understand whether information is shared or used for targeted advertising
  • Limit certain uses or processing of personal information
  • Opt out of certain targeted advertising activities

The specific rights available to you may vary depending on your state of residence and applicable law.

9. Third-Party Links

This website may contain links to external websites, products, or services.

Once you leave this website and visit a third-party website, your activity will be governed by that third party’s own terms of use and privacy policy.

We do not control how third-party websites collect, use, disclose, or retain information. We recommend reviewing their privacy policies before using their services.

10. Data Retention and Security

We retain information only for as long as reasonably necessary for website operations, communication, legal compliance, security, and other legitimate purposes.

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to help protect information against:

  • Unauthorized access
  • Improper use or disclosure
  • Accidental loss or damage
  • Malicious attacks or alteration

However, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is completely secure. We therefore cannot guarantee the absolute security of information transmitted to or stored by the website.

11. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on the laws that apply in your location, you may have the right to:

  • Request access to your personal information
  • Correct inaccurate or incomplete information
  • Request deletion of certain personal information
  • Restrict or object to certain types of processing
  • Withdraw consent previously provided
  • Request a copy of eligible personal information

To submit a privacy-related request, please contact us at:

Email: admin@tood.win

To protect your information, we may need to verify your identity or confirm the authenticity of your request before responding.

12. Children’s Privacy

This website is intended for a general audience and is not specifically designed for children.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children below the minimum legal age required in their jurisdiction.

If you believe that a child has submitted personal information without the consent of a parent or legal guardian, please contact us. We will review the matter and take appropriate action where necessary.

13. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in website features, third-party services, legal requirements, or data-processing practices.

Any revised version will be published on this page, and the “Last updated” date at the top of the page will be changed accordingly.

We recommend reviewing this page periodically to stay informed about the latest version of this Privacy Policy.

14. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, our use of cookies, or how personal information is handled, please contact us by email:

admin@tood.win

We will make reasonable efforts to review and respond to privacy-related questions and requests.
